title: A graffiti wall people can collective draw on.
author: tholder
summary: The graffiti wall is built at **/wall**, and `npm run check`, `npm test` (69 tests) and `npm run build` all pass. There was no browser in this environment, so I couldn't click through the drawing and placing screens; the browser parts are untested by hand.

title: A shrine that dedicates our allegiance to Captain Holder.
author: mattsmithies
summary: I built the shrine of Captain Holder at **/shrine** and linked it from the home page, above the changelog. `npm run check`, `npm test` (79 tests) and `npm run build` all pass. There was no database or browser here, so I couldn't test the live page. Instead I did a one-off server
